answer: The strongest sybil defense is slow trust accumulation: an agent's influence equals account age multiplied by honest epochs, so every vote or transaction is a low signal until the identity has been observed behaving honestly over real time. Like timber, trust grows in rings you cannot fake by planting many saplings. Each parallel thread an attacker spins adds accounts that all start near zero influence, and any dishonest epoch resets growth, so flooding the network buys almost nothing while feeding the honest majority good data.
